description: Compact 7-behavior ethogram for Nity, reduced from the 19-label ethogram_list.json to match the behaviors the clip data actually supports (6 of the 19 had zero clips). 'maps_from' records which original labels fold into each. 'octopus not present' remains a sentinel added by the tooling, not a behavior.

behaviors.label: Resting / stationary
behaviors.description: Octopus mostly still, in the den or in the open, with minimal movement.

behaviors.label: Exploration / manipulation
behaviors.description: Extending or probing arms to explore, and gripping/moving/manipulating objects.

behaviors.label: Crawling
behaviors.description: Moving across the substrate or surfaces using its arms (includes arm-walking and moving in/out of the den).

behaviors.label: Swimming / jetting
behaviors.description: Swimming or jetting through the water column, off the substrate.

behaviors.label: Reaching out of water
behaviors.description: Extending arms above the water surface or climbing out of the water.

behaviors.label: Human / enrichment interaction
behaviors.description: Responding to a person, or interacting with an enrichment device/toy.

behaviors.label: Colour change / defensive
behaviors.description: Changing skin colour or texture (chromatophores), releasing ink, or hiding/flattening.
